summary: Completed frontend testing of Clients & Buildings multi-tenant management module. All pages load correctly with proper navigation. Fixed one bug in BuildingDetailPage.js (SelectItem empty value error in Zone creation modal).
passed_tests: Clients Page (/clients) - Lists 2 clients with stats (2 Clients, 3 Bâtiments, 2 Radars, 2 Radars actifs)
Clients Page - Search functionality filters clients correctly
Clients Page - Create Client modal opens with all form fields
Client Detail Page (/clients/:id) - Shows client info, stats, and hierarchical tree view
Client Detail Page - Tree view displays buildings, floors, rooms with expand/collapse
Client Detail Page - Create Building modal opens correctly
Building Detail Page (/buildings/:id) - Shows floors table and zones table
Building Detail Page - Create Floor modal opens correctly
Building Detail Page - Create Zone modal opens correctly (FIXED: was throwing SelectItem empty value error)
Floor Detail Page (/floors/:id) - Shows rooms table with type, capacity, spaces, radars
Floor Detail Page - Shows zones for this floor
Floor Detail Page - Create Room modal with auto-create spaces checkboxes
Room Detail Page (/rooms/:id) - Shows spaces with assigned radars
Room Detail Page - Add Space modal opens correctly
Room Detail Page - Assign Radar modal opens correctly (shows 'no available radars' when all assigned)
Navigation between all pages via tree view and back buttons works correctly
seed_data_creation: None - Used existing demo data (2 clients: EHPAD Les Jardins du Parc, Résidence Seniors Les Cèdres)
